parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe how the Umayyads promoted Islam. You should refer to Fig. 1.1 and your own
knowledge in your answer.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘The Umayyad caliphs followed the Qurʿan in all that they did.’ Do you agree? You should
make reference to different points of view in your answer. 
OR

text: Study Fig. 1.1 which shows a Qurʿan of the Umayyad Period.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe how the ʿAbbasid caliphs demonstrated strong leadership, after the fall of the
Umayyads. You should refer to Fig. 2.1 and your own knowledge in your answer.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
To what extent did the leadership of the caliphate change under the ʿAbbasids? 
Section B
Answer EITHER Question 3 OR Question 4.
EITHER

text: Study Fig. 2.1 which shows an ʿAbbasid caliph’s palace in Iraq.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain how one significant writing, that you have studied, could express Islamic beliefs.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Discuss the different ways in which Muslims might explain their main beliefs to others
(daʿwah). 
OR

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain how beliefs about the afterlife are reflected in Islamic gardens.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘Gardens are the easiest way for Muslims to understand paradise.’ Evaluate this statement.
